title: Made CMS page
description: The initial content of a page: its path, its title and its strips in order. `php artisan made-cms:pages` creates the page when the site has no page at that path yet.

path.description: The path of the page on the site, e.g. "/" or "/lid-worden".

type.description: The key of a strip type in resources/cms/strips.

content.description: The values of the fields of the strip type.
